aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab develops software for food trucks and mobile catering: online ordering, pickup times, fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, helping them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time answering the same questions over and over.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was born to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software for them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around exactly how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people find food trucks visiting their area, I spent more time learning about the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always moving, selling at many different places and serving customers in constantly changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the collection times your kitchen can really make in time. The software works from each dish’s preparation time and the number of portions you can make at once.

comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up a weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for exactly the place and day you are there.

comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported yet.

comparison.faq.whatA: Ordering software takes orders online before customers reach the truck: customers choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. Till software or a card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or financial year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers pre-order for a later date or time, before the event takes place.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are confirmed automatically — you don’t need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to an order when you hand out the buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen facing customers, showing order numbers and when food is ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food safety, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before documents expire, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming schedule on your own website. Each selling date links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how many dishes the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty cards — collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into combos and suggest add-on items at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like automatic replies on WhatsApp, for messages from Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live order list.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login accounts with the right access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: When you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers don’t place orders you can’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how many dishes you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a pickup time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the truck — and the card machine you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering software assumes you have a fixed address, stable wifi and the same selling hours every week. But you are somewhere different each week, at different times, with patchy or no phone signal. HatchGrab was made for exactly that situation.
landing.does.offlineBody: When you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers don’t place orders you can’t see. You keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.

landing.does.title: For food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where is the truck tonight?” “What desserts are there?” Your WhatsApp gets answered automatically while you are driving to the pitch or cooking, based on your own menu and selling schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
